web_fixture.title: Sending limits - Windrow reference
web_fixture.snippet: A standard-plan workspace may send 14 messages per second; trial workspaces are documented separately.
web_fixture.content:
# Sending limits

Windrow reference, reviewed 2026-07-03.

A workspace on a standard plan may send 14 messages per second. The limit is
counted per workspace and applies to every sending endpoint; messages over the
limit are rejected with 429 and can be retried after 1 second.

A standard plan also carries a daily ceiling of 250000 messages and accepts
messages up to 25 MB with attachments.

web_fixture.title: Trial limits - Windrow reference
web_fixture.snippet: A trial workspace may send 3 messages per second and 5000 messages per day.
web_fixture.content:
# Trial limits

Windrow reference, reviewed 2026-07-03.

A trial workspace may send 3 messages per second and 5000 messages per day.
Trial workspaces can send only to addresses verified in the workspace, and
attachments are not processed.

Moving a workspace to a paid plan lifts the trial ceilings.
